exposure: obstetric interventions (caesarean, use of forceps, vacuum or non-specified instruments)
Hospitals were stratified into four strata based on the annual number of births
Obstetric interventions (Caesarean, forceps, vacuum, non-specified instruments)
cohort: Pregnant women giving birth in 44 public and 20 private hospitals in Catalonia between 2007 and 2012
finding: Caesarean section rates were stable in public hospitals but showed signs of increasing in private hospitals in Catalonia between 2007 and 2012.
mod_finding: This study found that Cesarean section rates were stable in public hospitals in Catalonia but increasing in private hospitals.
